summary: Sprint 14.1.2b — TwelveData key persistence fix (fragmented storage bug) verified end-to-end. All required pytest suites pass. E2E integration tests confirm all three legacy admin save endpoints (market_data/settings, market/settings, forex/settings) shadow-write to canonical `market_provider_config._id=active.twelvedata_api_key` AND live-propagate into the running ProviderManager (fingerprint visible in /api/market/debug/xauusd without restart). Startup migration confirmed: seeded ONLY `market_data_settings.api_keys.twelvedata` with SEED_LEGACY_MIGRATION_TEST_1234, restarted backend — canonical collection auto-populated, backend.err.log shows `market_providers.startup: migrated twelvedata api_key from market_data_settings.api_keys.twelvedata (len=31)` followed by `loaded twelvedata api_key (len=31, fp=SEED…34)`; debug endpoint reports `read_db_config.matches_in_memory=true` and `db_key_present=true`. Debug verdict for fake key = `INVALID_API_KEY` (HTTP 401 from TwelveData) — the previous `NOT_CONFIGURED`/`EXCEPTION_Exception` regression is fixed. Previously-flaky `test_refresh_interval_set_and_clamps` now passes 3/3 consecutive runs. No regressions in market_providers/status or PUT /market_providers/api-key (still returns provider/configured/test_ok/test_result). DB left WIPED at end of run (canonical twelvedata_api_key = '').
critical_code_review_comments: key_store.py is clean, well-documented, idempotent; canonical-first with legacy fallback chain is a solid self-healing design.
propagate_api_key resets circuit-breaker state so the next tick immediately uses the new key — correct.

Test isolation note: my E2E persistence tests leave the DB clean (autouse wipe fixture), but running them together with test_iter28's `test_status_providers_list` in the same session can transiently overlap because the assertion `provs['twelvedata']['configured'] is False` reads live manager state. Not a bug in the fix — just test ordering. Ran cleanly in isolation. Consider guarding that specific assertion in test_iter28 with a pre-test wipe helper for future-proofing.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: 4 admin UI pages wrote the same key to 4 different Mongo collections, only market_provider_config was read by ProviderManager. Fix (verified working): (a) new key_store.canonical_write/read/migrate_legacy_keys, (b) ProviderManager._load_config calls migrate on startup, (c) new propagate_api_key pushes key into live manager, (d) three legacy PUT endpoints now shadow-write + live-propagate, (e) debug verdict mapper distinguishes INVALID_API_KEY vs NOT_CONFIGURED vs PROVIDER_5XX. Repro proof: seeded key ONLY in legacy market_data_settings → after backend restart the log shows migration line and set_api_key called, canonical Mongo doc updated, debug endpoint reports matches_in_memory=true.
